exports.text: Insertion widens to cover conflicts with retry; removal, bounded adjust, split reservation, and locked named request plus exact release descend through transparent nodes.
Adjustable release frees shrinks or bisects with child move; compatible RAM merges; alignment from mode bits; free discovery supports descending private claims.

Sanity and exclusivity queries over iomem plus list wrappers using supplied or embedded spare entries with uniform disposal.

hazards.text: Early revocation before publish ignored and relaxed allowance skips unmap else full unmap with active versus noop variants; bad reservation release warns.
User-memory faults during rseq access force fault signals without partial state; expired deadline still reschedules; out-of-range debug address faults.

invariants.text: Ordered disjoint siblings under containing parent; transparent traversed; bounds stay inside avoid neighbours cover children; union outer on overlap, intersection shared only on overlap.
Alignment from two mode bits only; free scan ascends from aligned base or descends from capped top with wrap-aware stop; early init pins iomem fs and publishes inode with release.
Length versus original size and alignment checked; register installs matched state; unregister needs matching triple; identical retry busy, address/length mismatch invalid, signature mismatch denied.
Slice enable needs supported feature v2 registration and consistent flags; duration accepts decimal within min-max; boot booleans install monotonic pinned per-CPU timers.
Rseq debug via branch flag boot text and privileged file; per-CPU counters summed racy as decimal lines; stats and slice init have active versus inert build variants.
Selection ignores zero weight rejects overflow; handler checks inbound marking and CPU placement with delays then completes or recycles; random reseeds periodically; hotplug stats conditional.

locks.text: Mutations hold global write guard across search plus link/unlink; inspections hold read guard; multiplexed acquire sleeps outside guard then retries with wakeup after unlink.
Rseq snapshot runs interrupt-masked for local atomicity; slice entry disables preemption and timer/cookie rely on CPU locality with identity check.

state_machines.text: Split loops attempt absorb trim carve; locked request descends waits or fails; adjustable release frees shrinks bisects then coalesces; free scan skips overlaps then claims.
Slowpath snapshots and refreshes or faults; unregistered to registered via validation, back only via validated unregister; slice disabled to enabled to granted to revoked with latched yield.
Threads alternate work and shutdown parking until stop observable; selection accumulates weights and samples first covering entry within total.

structs.text: Device interval key parent/start/length; list wrapper node plus supplied or embedded resource; iomem pseudo-fs id; test helper inputs plus expected outcome; suite of three cases.
Slice timer plus cookie per CPU; torture per-thread tallies; selector weight plus id/wait with length/total; check markers target completion and freelist node.
Free-search descending and request bits; default align build-dependent; boot reserve table four entries; strict iomem default enabled versus disabled by build.
